reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for monitoring session token usage and estimated costs through a /cost command and a draggable floating web UI panel.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 /cost 命令和可拖拽悬浮面板查看会话的模型、Token 用量及估算费用。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the current session model, token usage, and estimated cost through a /cost command and draggable floating panel.

capabilities: Reads session token-usage events or projection snapshots
Calculates estimated costs using configured model pricing and time tiers
Exposes session cost data through a host HTTP route
Renders a draggable browser-side floating cost panel
Stores the panel position in browser local storage
